coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Excluded donation drives, resource guides, routine distribution schedules, opinion, historical grocery fires, old pantry closures, prior SNAP shutdown stories from 2025, and unverified claims or index freshness without event-time evidence.
coverage_notes.assessment: No new qualifying development verified within the narrow hourly window. The November 6 McCaysville sole-grocery loss is material in underlying Food Line subject matter but is historical relative to this watch and therefore not presented as new. Search indexing lag and provider updates not indexed publicly limit any claim of nationwide completeness.
